name: Cupertino Youth Activity Board (YAB)
org: City of Cupertino, Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Join a team of 13 middle and high school students. You plan and run events for Cupertino kids and teens. You work with city staff and the Teen Commission.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 8 to 11 for the next school year. Anyone in those grades may apply. Students who live in Cupertino get picked first.
duration: One school-year term (for example, the 2027-28 term).
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 term closed Sunday, May 3, 2026. The page says applications for the 2027-28 term open in March 2027.
how_to_apply: Answer four short questions (up to 300 words each). Send one letter from someone who is not family, on their work paper, to robertk@cupertino.gov. Share a one minute YouTube video about you. It can be private or unlisted. Late items are not taken.
notes: Past events: Hack Cupertino, Pizza and Politics, a teen speaker series and the Cupertino Spelling Bee. Members plan an event about every other month. The 2027 last day is not posted. Last year it closed in early May.
